task: Migrate SDK to REV 0.3 with whole-PR coverage and retain existing checks.

criteria.description: The unprivileged preparation job collects the complete committed PR diff using the pinned REV collector, including changed workflow and acceptance files, and packages the exact head/base revisions, original request, task and actual behavioral observations. A mismatched checkout or unmapped changed file fails collection. Tests exercise successful packaging and both negative cases.

The PR evaluator uses pinned REV 0.3 in pull-request scope with change-file, explicit head and base, and a PR-specific trusted repository variable for the reviewed contract digest. The evaluator job reads artifacts only and executes no application PR code. Missing or altered contracts and incomplete coverage deny; accepted criteria alone cannot approve. Tests exercise these negative cases.

SDK retains all existing CI checks as required REV dependencies. It recognizes both the standard TYPESAFE_API_KEY and the existing TUPESAFE_API_KEY secret names, without printing secret values. Collection and evaluator jobs do not install or execute application code with the API key.

Documentation explains how to update request, criteria, file mappings and relevant evidence per PR, obtain review and pin a PR-specific digest outside PR content. It distinguishes coverage from merge readiness and forbids automatic digest approval or acceptance-mode bypasses. The rollout supplies these configuration files, preserves existing public APIs and introduces no release payload.
